LanguageData.PAS_Settings1: Which animals should be kept safe?
LanguageData.PAS_Settings2: Warning: protecting all animals may cause issues with raiders and predators.
LanguageData.PAS_Settings3: Should animals be kept safe from all damage, or just from enemies?
LanguageData.PAS_ExcludeList_tooltip: Animal types excluded from general settings.
LanguageData.PAS_AllAnimals_tooltip: Protect all animals. Don't forget to disable manhunters!
LanguageData.PAS_SpecificAnimals_tooltip: A gizmo will appear for each animal, where you can toggle on or off protection
LanguageData.PAS_AllSources_tooltip: Prevent damage from all sources, including things like fire and collapsing roofs.
LanguageData.PAS_PawnSources_tooltip: Only prevent damage from living sources, like humans and other animals. Also mechanoids, undead, etc. Things that move around, I guess.
LanguageData.PAS_Ignore_tooltip: Do nothing when damaged. Will cause enemies to just keep attacking forever.
LanguageData.PAS_PlayDead_tooltip: Play dead when damaged. Last for four in-game hours.
